verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API (docs-35, probe-4), and it markets agent-first developer tools (docs-36). Together these offer an indirect, first-party route to driving Stripe through natural language from an external AI client. Nothing shows that this covers Terminal operations such as readers, locations or in-person payments, and there is no native natural-language interface in the product itself. Missing for 10: evidence that MCP tools cover Terminal reader and payment operations, a native natural-language command interface in the Terminal Dashboard or app, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language Terminal workflows.
